scope: NBHL ball hockey only; sequence event detection, not ball-near-net counting.
definition: SOG = a legal attacking shot, tip, or deflection that scores or would enter the goal if not stopped by the goalkeeper. Exclude wide/high attempts, post/crossbar-only attempts, skater blocks, harmless passes, goalie collection of wide balls, and disallowed goals. Count a distinct rebound shot separately. Unknown outcome or on-target path is not confirmed SOG.
